title: The header honestly records that the measured neighbour len=78 -> x=5 is not re…
body: The header honestly records that the measured neighbour len=78 -> x=5 is not reproduced bit-exactly by the simplified capacity model, while len=77 (the load-bearing boundary) is exact. This is the right call over gerrymandering the fixture. If Ink's wrap arithmetic is ever needed more faithfully, that divergence is the place to start.
